create_activation_function: create a PyTorch activation module by name from relu, gelu, swish, sigmoid, or identity
build_streaming_attention_mask: build an adaptive encoder mask tensor for transformer transducer streaming mode with configurable chunk windows
create_glu_module: create a Gated Linear Unit module that splits input and applies a configurable activation to the gate
create_convolutional_subsample: create a NeMo-style convolutional subsampling module with striding, depthwise striding, or 1d variants
build_multihead_attention: build a multi-head attention module with optional grouped query attention, relative position bias, and GLU
